item.content:encoded:
Fantastic series of tales. I stumbled upon SCP-4040 by accident last summer, and decided to save this for the Halloween season. Just finished it about a week after Halloween (being a high school teacher is time sink unfortunately), but the second I finished I looked up it had started lightly snowing, just some mild flurries, but the first of the season. Perfect thematic finish to accompany the story.

It'll be hard but I think I'll save Black Autumn II for next year. In the meanwhile, I'm gonna read the rest of the S&C Plastics canon, I love this setting.

Seriously, amazing job here.

item.title: My Author Commentary Flows So Sweet. Taste and See.
item.content:encoded:
So, yeah. My stupid Halloween thing has a hub now. I couldn't think of a good way to present it, but then I remembered that The Secret World (Now Secret World Legends) is a thing, and I essentially ripped off the way they present the lore in that game. It's probably the closest an MMO can get to the horror genre. I'm not mimicking the style of the Buzzing perfectly, but it'll work for the purposes of this.

Part 4 of Black Autumn goes up in a few hours. So I'm kind of flooding most recently created with this. Oh well.

Mood Music: The Secret World- Main Theme
